change: Preserve a one-element loop pattern as a pattern, rather than collapsing it to the name or nested pattern it contains.
command: python3 -m tools.core test -k 'unpack or sequence or comprehension'
regression: Before the change, [x] binds the whole array or record, and [[x]] drops a nesting level. New value cases fail against b06183e9.
coverage: Native/web default/release single/nested arrays, record fields, custom sequences, comprehensions, combined headers and length failures; adjacent unpacking, sequence and comprehension checks.
compatibility: Every bracket level now has meaning, consistent with declaration/parameter patterns. Three older positive loop fixtures and one negative fixture now provide genuinely nested inputs. Plain-name loop bindings are unchanged.
notes: Focused gate on a compiler derived from the preceding independent C bootstrap. Hosted CI runs the full C gate. No performance claim.
